heading: The weekend, day by day
intro: A little structure, plenty of mountain time. Here is the general plan for the weekend; details may change as plans come together.

days.title: Hello, Montana
days.summary: Land, stock up, and settle into mountain life.

activities.title: The plan
activities.description: Arrive in Bozeman, pick up rental gear, and help with grocery and other arrival-day errands before heading to the house for pizza and an easy evening together.

days.title: First tracks
days.summary: Ski Yellowstone Club, then spend the evening together.

activities.title: The plan
activities.description: Ski at Yellowstone Club, then gather for après-ski and hot tub time at the house before heading out for dinner and drinks.

days.title: Mountain time
days.summary: Ski Yellowstone Club, then head to Église and curling.

activities.title: The plan
activities.description: Ski at Yellowstone Club, with an optional morning backcountry outing. Dinner at the house follows curling.

activities.title: Lunch on the mountain
activities.description: Plan to stop at the on-mountain pizza hut for lunch.

days.title: Birthday in the mountains
days.summary: Ski Big Sky Resort and celebrate with a birthday lunch on the mountain.

activities.title: The plan
activities.description: Ski at Big Sky Resort, with a flexible afternoon for more turns or hot tub time. Gather at the house for golden-hour photos and a birthday steak dinner.

days.title: One last coffee
days.summary: A slow morning before the journey home.

activities.title: The plan
activities.description: Enjoy breakfast, pack up, and head back to Bozeman for rental returns and flights home.
